concurrency: sequential (1 request at a time, no client-side batching)
retry_policy: no retries -- every failed request is counted once, never re-attempted
notes: max_tokens raised to 1200 (vs 300 for Qwen3/Ministral) -- technically necessary because this model always emits chain-of-thought reasoning directly into content with no way to suppress it via enable_thinking (that flag is Qwen3-specific and is silently ignored here); 300 tokens was insufficient for the model to complete reasoning and emit the final JSON answer. All other settings (prompt, schema, temperature, seed, scenario set) are identical across all three models.
